projects.name: Dynamic Hypergraph Coarsening with structural properties & HGNN performance preservation
projects.summary: Investigating Coarsening methods for Temporal Hypergraph for various machine learning applications, preserving structural properties like cut, flow, conductance and Hypergraph Neural Network performance.
highlights: Developed a novel framework for making Temporal Updates to Coarse Hypergraphs
Achieved up to 55x speedup from a full-recomputation-based baseline
Developed mathematical guarantees for deviation from baseline
Under Review at AISTATS 2026

projects.name: Physics Informed Diffusion Model for Flood Modelling and Prediction
projects.summary: Developing a first-of-its-kind diffusion model for flood prediction in both fluvial and pluvial contexts.
highlights: Developed a preliminary version of the Graph-based Diffusion architecture for flood modelling in urban context
Learned Diffusion (DDPM) and Graph Neural Networks Based Methods for Urban Flood Prediction

projects.name: ProGNN: Residue-level GNN for Secondary Structure & RSA Prediction
projects.summary: Converted PDB/mmCIF structures into residue graphs for per-residue SS and ASA labels.
highlights: Engineered node/edge features and built a PyG pipeline for dataset discovery and preprocessing
Implemented a 2-layer GCN with dual heads for 3-class secondary-structure classification and RSA regression

projects.name: Kernel Based Graph Condensation Algorithm for comparable GNN performance
projects.summary: Developed a graph distillation technique to reduce computational complexity, preserving GNN performance.
highlights: Developed a scalable algorithm utilizing GNTK with Nyström approximation and kernel K-Means
Enabled up to 80% graph size reduction with less than 1% GNN accuracy loss on Cora

projects.name: Hub Based Graph Construction Techniques for HNSW
projects.summary: Proposed and implemented a supervised Graph Construction technique for the Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithm for ANN search using Hubness theory.
highlights: Explored the phenomenon of hubness in high-dimensional spaces
Achieved perfect recall with 125x faster build times, slightly lesser query time & 82% fewer edges than vanilla HNSW

projects.name: Graph Transformer Networks for Molecular Dipole Prediction
projects.summary: Developed a Graph Transformer Network-based model for predicting molecular dipoles using spatial positions of atoms in a molecule.
highlights: Integrated 3D spatial positional encodings and attention-based message passing
Model performance was compared with the graph neural network baseline

projects.name: Next Line Predictor Chatbot with Multilayer Perceptron
projects.summary: Developed a Next-line predictor using a multilayer perceptron and deployed it using Streamlit.
highlights: Trained a multilayer perceptron for various sets of hyperparameters and analyzed its impact on model performance
